summary: Build practical digital marketing strategy skills in five days. Create campaigns, dashboards, content plans, and optimization roadmaps. Enquire today.
lede: Digital marketing training helps digital marketing managers, content strategists, and campaign specialists connect audience needs with channel plans and business outcomes. Learners practise audience segmentation, customer journey mapping, search intent analysis, and content and paid media planning, using frameworks such as RACE and PESO. They also use Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console to interpret performance and develop an integrated campaign plan, KPI scorecard, and optimization priorities.
audienceIntro: Digital marketing strategy training suits professionals who coordinate digital channels, manage campaign activity, create customer-facing content, analyse marketing data, or advise leaders on growth priorities. It supports foundation to intermediate learners who need a connected planning method rather than isolated platform instruction.
prerequisites: This foundation-to-intermediate course requires basic workplace experience with marketing, communications, sales, customer engagement, or digital channels. No coding or programming is required. You should be comfortable using spreadsheets and web browsers, and you may bring a current campaign, product, service, or communication challenge for applied exercises. Advanced analytics, paid media configuration, marketing automation, and AI-assisted content workflows are taught at operational application level, not production engineering level.
